verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only ways for external AI clients to drive Cal.com: a hosted MCP server, an API v2 for agents, and a CLI for agents. Nothing documents a built-in AI assistant inside the Cal.com product that users can delegate tasks to. These external-agent interfaces are adjacent building blocks and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
